title: QUIC RFC 9000 Packet Classification And Connection Association Work Item
summary: Close the bounded S5P2 packet classification and association floor by adding focused requirement-home proof for endpoint routing, listener Initial admission, zero-length connection-ID routing, version mismatch discard, and weakly protected invalid packet discard.
planned_changes:
- Add shared S5P2 endpoint association test support.
- Add focused tests for incoming packet classification, existing connection association, server Initial admission, non-zero Destination Connection ID routing, zero-length connection-ID route matching, and local-endpoint mismatch rejection.
- Retarget existing S5P2 packet-number-space, version mismatch, and weakly protected invalid packet tests to method-level x_test_refs.
- Add focused architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts for the closed S5P2 association floor.
- Regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage and update status ledgers.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S5P2 requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0013 rollback of weakly protected packet side effects.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused endpoint ingress and association proof for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0001 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0006, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0008, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0009, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0011.
